intent: whether every product price shown in the order summary item is formatted as US dollars with two decimal places

action_params.condition: Every product price is shown in US dollars with two decimals, like $28.00.
action_params.query: whether every product price shown in the order summary item is formatted as US dollars with two decimal places
action_params.code_js: (() => { const prices = Array.from(el(32).querySelectorAll('*')).map(n => n.innerText.trim()).filter(t => /^[$]\d+\.\d{2}$/.test(t)); return prices.length > 0 && prices.every(t => /^[$]\d+\.\d{2}$/.test(t)); })()

intent: whether every amount in the order summary is formatted as US dollars with two decimal places or shown as Free

action_params.condition: Every amount in a cart or order summary is shown in US dollars with two decimals, like $28.00.
action_params.query: whether every amount in the order summary is formatted as US dollars with two decimal places or shown as Free
action_params.code_js: (() => { const amounts = Array.from(el(33).querySelectorAll('dd')).map(n => n.innerText.trim()); return amounts.length > 0 && amounts.every(t => t === 'Free' || /^[-−]?[$]\d+\.\d{2}$/.test(t)); })()

action_instruction: Reading the shipping amount from the order summary
intent: the shipping amount text in the order summary

action_params.query: the shipping amount text in the order summary
